reset_policy: Reload config/kitchen.json before every independent trial.
retry_policy: At most one validator-guided correction after the first response.
interruption_policy: Retain failed API or runtime trials; resume only missing trial IDs.
exclusion_policy: Exclude no completed trial silently. Record and justify exclusions in the trial index.
pilot_policy: Run one command from each category before freezing; pilot records are not part of final results.
webots_confirmation: Put the apple in the basket.
Move the mug from the shelf to the table.
Put the mug in the cupboard and close it.
